name: Gardens by the Bay
description: 新加坡地标级景点，超级树、云雾林、花穹三大看点，傍晚灯光秀室外免费观看。建议下午16点后再去，避开正午暴晒，顺便看晚上的灯光秀。
descriptionEn: Singapore's landmark attraction, famous for the Supertree Grove, Cloud Forest, and Flower Dome. The outdoor light show in the evening is free to watch. Best visited after 4pm to avoid the midday heat and catch the night light show.
openingHoursEn: 5:00 AM - 2:00 AM (Cloud Forest / Flower Dome: 9:00 AM - 9:00 PM)

attractionFeatures.bestTimeVisit: 16:00 后（避开正午暴晒，顺便看 19:45 灯光秀）
attractionFeatures.bestTimeVisitEn: After 4:00 PM (avoids midday heat, catch the 7:45 PM light show)
attractionFeatures.ticketPriceDesc: 户外区域免费；云雾林/花穹成人约 S$32-53
attractionFeatures.ticketPriceDescEn: Outdoor areas free; Cloud Forest/Flower Dome approx. S$32-53 for adults
highlights: 云雾林 (Cloud Forest) 35米高室内瀑布
超级树灯光秀 (Garden Rhapsody, 每日 19:45 / 20:45)
OCBC Skyway 空中走廊
highlightsEn: Cloud Forest: 35m indoor waterfall
Supertree light show (Garden Rhapsody, daily 7:45 PM / 8:45 PM)
OCBC Skyway aerial walkway

name: East Coast Park
description: 本地人周末骑车、烧烤、看海的地方，沿海骑行道很长，适合租自行车逛一圈，傍晚风大很舒服。
descriptionEn: A local favorite for weekend cycling, BBQs, and seaside strolls. The coastal cycling path is long, great for renting a bike; evenings are breezy and pleasant.

attractionFeatures.bestTimeVisit: 傍晚 17:00 后（更凉爽，能看日落）
attractionFeatures.ticketPriceDesc: 免费开放，自行车租赁另计费
attractionFeatures.ticketPriceDescEn: Free entry; bike rental charged separately
highlights: 沿海骑行道
烧烤场地
水上运动中心
highlightsEn: Coastal cycling path
BBQ pits
Water sports centre

name: Sentosa Yacht Charter (Infinity Sails)
nameCn: 圣淘沙游艇俱乐部--游艇出海
description: 由 Infinity Sails 提供的 46 英尺双体动力游艇（MY Escapade）出海体验，最大承载约 30-32 人。航线自圣淘沙升涛湾出发前往南部岛屿（如 Lazarus Island），船上配备飞桥区、空调休息室、KTV 音响及 BBQ 烧烤设施，非常适合团体出海与水上娱乐。
descriptionEn: A 46-ft power catamaran (MY Escapade) charter by Infinity Sails, holding up to 30-32 guests. Departs from Sentosa Cove for the Southern Islands (e.g. Lazarus Island). Onboard features a flybridge deck, air-conditioned saloon, KTV sound system and BBQ facilities — great for group outings and water fun.
address: 1 Cove Ave, #02-12 Sentosa Cove Arrival Plaza, Singapore 098537
openingHours: 预订制（典型出海时段如 10:00 - 15:00，共 5 小时）需找到对应船只中介的Whatsapp号码预定
openingHoursEn: By appointment only (typical trip 10:00 AM - 3:00 PM, 5 hours); book via the charter agent's WhatsApp

attractionFeatures.bestTimeVisit: 白天出航（如 10:00 - 15:00，适合水上活动与海上 BBQ），傍晚出航（16:00-20:00，更加凉爽且拥有无遮挡夜景）
attractionFeatures.bestTimeVisitEn: Daytime trips (e.g. 10 AM-3 PM) suit water activities and BBQ; evening trips (4 PM-8 PM) are cooler with unobstructed night views
attractionFeatures.ticketPriceDesc: 包船租赁按套餐与人数计费（参考：包船约 S$1,320/10人，随后S$70/人；BBQ 食材需额外采购，配送到码头）
attractionFeatures.ticketPriceDescEn: Charter priced by package and headcount (approx. S$1,320 for 10 pax, then S$70/person; BBQ supplies purchased separately and delivered to the jetty)
highlights: 46英尺动力双体游艇（MY Escapade），行驶稳定且空间宽敞
新加坡南部岛屿巡航（Lazarus Island / Eagle Bay 停泊游玩）
配备飞桥活动区、空调Saloon休息室、KTV音响与海上BBQ设施
highlightsEn: 46-ft power catamaran (MY Escapade), stable and spacious
Cruise to Singapore's Southern Islands (stop at Lazarus Island / Eagle Bay)
Flybridge deck, air-conditioned saloon, KTV sound system and BBQ facilities onboard

name: MacRitchie Reservoir Hiking Trail (South Entrance)
nameCn: 麦里芝水库徒步路线（南部公交站进出）
description: 新加坡经典的徒步胜地，环湖总长约11公里。沿途可欣赏热带雨林并偶遇野生动物。建议行前做好防蚊措施；切勿手提塑料袋或喂食猴子。林间土路段休息区较少，请量力而行。
descriptionEn: A classic Singapore hiking spot with an ~11km loop around the reservoir. Enjoy tropical rainforest scenery and possible wildlife encounters along the way. Bring mosquito repellent; never carry plastic bags visibly or feed the monkeys. Rest points are scarce on the forest trail sections, so pace yourself.

attractionFeatures.bestTimeVisitEn: 7:00-9:00 AM or after 4:00 PM (avoid midday heat)
highlights: 路线全长：完整大环线约11公里，亦有3-5公里的短途折返路线，可根据体力自由选择
补给与洗手间：南部入口（起终点）及中途护林员站设有厕所和直饮水机，其余纯土路段无补给点，务必提前带足饮用水
防猴指南：绝对不要喂食！切勿手提塑料袋或边走边吃，避免与猴群对视，保持安全距离安静通过即可
野生动物防范：林区蚊虫较多，建议喷涂防蚊液；偶遇蛇或巨蜥属正常生态现象，保持冷静不惊扰、不靠近并绕行
休息区分布：入口公园、湖畔木栈道及护林员站设有较多长椅和凉亭，进入林间原始土路后休息点稀少
highlightsEn: Trail length: full loop ~11km, with shorter 3-5km out-and-back options depending on fitness level
Supplies & restrooms: available at the South Entrance (start/end point) and the ranger station midway; no supply points on the pure dirt-trail sections, so bring enough water
Monkey safety: never feed them! Don't carry visible plastic bags or eat while walking; avoid eye contact and just pass quietly at a safe distance
Wildlife caution: mosquitoes are common, use repellent; encountering snakes or monitor lizards is normal — stay calm, don't approach, and walk around them
Rest areas: plenty of benches and shelters near the entrance park, lakeside boardwalk and ranger station; very few once you're on the forest dirt trails

name: Singapore Zoo
description: 屡获殊荣的全开放式动物园。园内有精彩的《海洋动物表演》等特色演出，并设有阿明餐厅(Ah Meng Restaurant)等多家内部餐饮。园区提供免费游园摆渡车轻松代步，且到处都有直饮水机，强烈建议自带水壶接水。
descriptionEn: An award-winning, fully open-concept zoo. Features shows like the Splash Safari, plus several on-site eateries including Ah Meng Restaurant. Free shuttle trams make getting around easy, and water refill points are everywhere — bring a bottle.

attractionFeatures.bestTimeVisit: 上午 8:30 或下午（避开正午暴晒，合理安排看表演的时间）
attractionFeatures.bestTimeVisitEn: 8:30 AM or afternoon (avoid midday heat, plan around show times)
attractionFeatures.ticketPriceDesc: 成人约 S$48，儿童约 S$33
attractionFeatures.ticketPriceDescEn: Adults approx. S$48, children approx. S$33
highlights: 特色表演：海洋动物表演 (Splash Safari)、动物之友等
内部餐厅：阿明餐厅 (提供本地及西式餐饮)、KFC等
交通便利：提供免费摆渡车 (游园车) 环游园区
环保设施：园区到处可以接水，带水壶即可免费饮用
highlightsEn: Shows: Splash Safari, Animal Friends and more
Dining: Ah Meng Restaurant (local & Western food), KFC and more
Getting around: free shuttle tram around the park
Eco-friendly: free water refill points throughout the park — bring a bottle

name: Night Safari
description: 全球首个专为夜间动物设立的野生动物园。游客可乘坐游园车穿梭于不同地理区域观察夜行动物的真实状态，或漫步于步行小径近距离探索，是极具特色的夜间体验。
descriptionEn: The world's first wildlife park designed for nocturnal animals. Ride the tram through different geographic zones to observe nocturnal animals in their natural state, or explore up close on foot along the walking trails — a truly unique night-time experience.

attractionFeatures.bestTimeVisit: 19:15 入园（建议提前预订最早的入园场次，预留时间观看表演）
attractionFeatures.bestTimeVisitEn: Enter at 7:15 PM (book the earliest slot to leave time for the show)
attractionFeatures.ticketPriceDesc: 成人约 S$55，儿童约 S$38
attractionFeatures.ticketPriceDescEn: Adults approx. S$55, children approx. S$38
highlights: 游园车 (Guided Tram Ride)：约40分钟，配有英文或多语言语音导览
夜晚的精灵动物表演 (Creatures of the Night Show)
四条独特的步行小径 (Walking Trails)：如渔猫小径、花豹小径等
highlightsEn: Guided Tram Ride: ~40 minutes, with English or multilingual audio commentary
Creatures of the Night Show
Four unique walking trails, e.g. Fishing Cat Trail, Leopard Trail

name: River Wonders
nameCn: 河川生态园 (河川动物园)
description: 亚洲首个也是唯一一个以河川为主题的野生动物园。园区设有大量带顶棚的步道，不受日晒雨淋影响。必体验亚马逊河探索游船，并在大熊猫竹林探访大熊猫，以及在巨型水族馆观赏海牛。
descriptionEn: Asia's first and only river-themed wildlife park. Most walkways are covered, so you're sheltered from sun and rain. Don't miss the Amazon River Quest boat ride, a visit to the giant pandas at the Giant Panda Forest, and manatees in the giant aquarium.

attractionFeatures.bestTimeVisit: 全天皆可（有大量带顶棚区域，是雨天避雨或晴天避暑的好去处）
attractionFeatures.bestTimeVisitEn: Good any time of day (mostly covered, great for shelter from rain or heat)
attractionFeatures.ticketPriceDesc: 成人约 S$42，儿童约 S$30
attractionFeatures.ticketPriceDescEn: Adults approx. S$42, children approx. S$30
highlights: 亚马逊河探索游船 (Amazon River Quest)：乘船沉浸式观赏野生动物
大熊猫竹林 (Giant Panda Forest)：探访大熊猫
亚马逊洪溢林 (Amazon Flooded Forest)：在巨型水族馆观赏海牛
highlightsEn: Amazon River Quest: an immersive boat ride to see wildlife
Giant Panda Forest: visit the giant pandas
Amazon Flooded Forest: see manatees in the giant aquarium

name: Bird Paradise
nameCn: 飞禽公园 (万态飞禽公园)
description: 亚洲最大的飞禽公园，全新迁至万态野生动物世界。园区拥有八大沉浸式大型步入式鸟舍，展示全球多种珍稀飞禽。必看精彩的飞禽表演以及设有冷气设施的室内企鹅湾。
descriptionEn: Asia's largest bird park, newly relocated to Mandai Wildlife Reserve. Features eight immersive walk-in aviaries showcasing rare bird species from around the world. Don't miss the bird shows and the air-conditioned indoor Penguin Cove.

attractionFeatures.bestTimeVisit: 上午 9:00 或下午（避开正午暴晒，合理安排观看两场主打飞禽表演的时间）
attractionFeatures.bestTimeVisitEn: 9:00 AM or afternoon (avoid midday heat, plan around the two main bird shows)
attractionFeatures.ticketPriceDesc: 成人约 S$48，儿童约 S$33
attractionFeatures.ticketPriceDescEn: Adults approx. S$48, children approx. S$33
highlights: 八大沉浸式步入式鸟舍 (Walk-in Aviaries)
企鹅湾 (Penguin Cove)：室内冷气环境，可观赏多种企鹅及水下动态
精彩飞禽表演：展翅高飞表演 (Wings of the World) 等
交通便利：园区内提供免费游园车接驳
highlightsEn: Eight immersive walk-in aviaries
Penguin Cove: air-conditioned indoor habitat with multiple penguin species and underwater views
Bird shows including Wings of the World
Convenient: free shuttle tram within the park

name: Rainforest Wild Adventure
description: 亚洲首个以探险为核心的野生动物园，分为西区(亚洲)和东区(非洲)两大区域。巧妙结合了丛林徒步、空中步道、模拟探洞与野生动物观赏(如马来亚虎、㺢㹢狓等)，带来独一无二的沉浸式热带雨林探险体验。
descriptionEn: Asia's first adventure-focused wildlife park, split into the West Zone (Asia) and East Zone (Africa). It combines jungle trekking, aerial walkways, a simulated cave exploration and wildlife viewing (Malayan tigers, okapis and more) for a truly immersive rainforest adventure.

attractionFeatures.bestTimeVisit: 上午 9:00（由于包含体力消耗较大的户外探险项目，建议趁早晨天气相对凉爽时前往）
attractionFeatures.bestTimeVisitEn: 9:00 AM (the outdoor adventure activities are physically demanding, so go while it's cooler in the morning)
attractionFeatures.ticketPriceDesc: 成人约 S$43，儿童约 S$31（一票通玩东西两区，部分进阶探险项目如树冠滑翔需符合身高要求）
attractionFeatures.ticketPriceDescEn: Adults approx. S$43, children approx. S$31 (one ticket covers both zones; some advanced activities like the Canopy Glider have height requirements)
highlights: 丛林探险体验：体验树冠滑翔 (Canopy Glider) 和树冠攀爬 (Treetop Traverse)
特色洞穴探险 (Wild Cavern Adventure)：在布满钟乳石的洞穴内体验黑暗中探索的乐趣
野生动物寻踪：西区观赏马来亚虎和马来貘，东区寻找首次亮相东南亚的㺢㹢狓 (Okapi)
沉浸式观景：穿行于高空栈道 (Elevated Walkways) 和悬索桥，多视角俯瞰雨林
highlightsEn: Jungle adventures: Canopy Glider and Treetop Traverse
Wild Cavern Adventure: explore a stalactite-filled cave in the dark
Wildlife spotting: Malayan tigers and tapirs in the West Zone; okapis (first debut in Southeast Asia) in the East Zone
Immersive views: elevated walkways and suspension bridges offering multiple vantage points over the rainforest

name: Clarke Quay Jetty (Singapore River Cruise)
nameCn: 克拉码头 (新加坡河游船)
description: 新加坡河经典的游船体验起点。单场游船时长约40分钟，游船路径自克拉码头出发，途径驳船码头（Boat Quay），前往滨海湾（Marina Bay）欣赏地标后折返。强烈推荐夜晚乘船，可饱览绚丽的城市天际线与金沙灯光秀。请注意，晚间热门时段乘船预计需排队 30-45 分钟。
descriptionEn: The classic starting point for a Singapore River cruise. Each ride is about 40 minutes, departing from Clarke Quay, passing Boat Quay, and heading to Marina Bay to view the landmarks before looping back. Highly recommended at night for the dazzling skyline and Marina Bay Sands light show. Note: expect a 30-45 minute queue during popular evening slots.
address: 3 River Valley Rd, Clarke Quay Jetty, Singapore 058282

attractionFeatures.bestTimeVisit: 19:00 - 21:00（强烈推荐夜晚乘船，赏夜景及金沙灯光秀）
attractionFeatures.bestTimeVisitEn: 7:00-9:00 PM (highly recommended at night for the skyline and Marina Bay Sands light show)
attractionFeatures.ticketPriceDesc: 成人约 S$28，儿童约 S$18
attractionFeatures.ticketPriceDescEn: Adults approx. S$28, children approx. S$18
highlights: 单场游玩时长：约 40 分钟
游船路径：克拉码头 -> 驳船码头 -> 滨海湾 -> 原路折返
热门时段预计排队时间：30-45 分钟
绝佳水上视角欣赏鱼尾狮、滨海湾金沙等地标夜景
highlightsEn: Ride duration: approx. 40 minutes
Route: Clarke Quay → Boat Quay → Marina Bay → back
Expected queue during peak hours: 30-45 minutes
Great water-level views of the Merlion, Marina Bay Sands and other landmarks at night

name: Singapore Botanic Gardens
description: 拥有逾160年历史的新加坡首个联合国教科文组织世界文化遗产。园内不仅有丰富的热带珍稀植物和举世闻名的国家兰花园，还汇聚了多间优质餐厅。搭乘地铁至植物园站（Botanic Gardens MRT）即可轻松直达，交通极其便利。
descriptionEn: Singapore's first UNESCO World Heritage Site, with over 160 years of history. Home to a rich collection of rare tropical plants and the world-famous National Orchid Garden, plus several excellent restaurants. Easily accessible via Botanic Gardens MRT station.
openingHoursEn: 5:00 AM - 12:00 AM (National Orchid Garden: 8:30 AM - 7:00 PM)

attractionFeatures.bestTimeVisitEn: 7:00-10:00 AM or after 4:00 PM (avoid midday heat)
attractionFeatures.ticketPriceDesc: 全园免费入场；国家兰花园需购票（成人 S$15，本地居民及优惠人群有折扣）
attractionFeatures.ticketPriceDescEn: Free entry to the gardens; National Orchid Garden requires a ticket (S$15 for adults, discounts for residents and concessions)
highlights: 国家兰花园 (National Orchid Garden) 赏千余种胡姬花
感受160余年历史的世界文化遗产底蕴
探索热带雨林区及百年珍稀植物
体验园内特色餐饮（如米其林餐厅Corner House、Botanico等）
highlightsEn: National Orchid Garden: over a thousand orchid varieties
Experience over 160 years of World Heritage history
Explore the rainforest zone and centuries-old rare plants
Dine at on-site restaurants like Michelin-starred Corner House and Botanico

name: Nam Kee Chicken Rice Restaurant
description: 创立于1968年的家族经营老字号，至今已传承三代。主打传统正宗的海南鸡饭，保留了古早味的怀旧装潢，是深受当地居民喜爱的平价食堂。位置便利，位于麦里芝水库东出入口附近，近CC16和TE8地铁站。
descriptionEn: A family-run heritage eatery established in 1968, now in its third generation. Known for authentic, traditional Hainanese chicken rice, with old-school nostalgic decor. A beloved affordable spot among locals, conveniently located near MacRitchie Reservoir's east entrance and CC16/TE8 MRT stations.

name: East Coast Lagoon Food Village
description: 新加坡唯一位于海滩旁的小贩中心，吹着海风品尝地道的沙嗲、烤魔鬼鱼和烤鸡全翅。紧邻东海岸公园，是本地人周末家庭聚餐和骑行后的宵夜圣地。
descriptionEn: Singapore's only beachside hawker centre, where you can enjoy authentic satay, grilled stingray and BBQ chicken wings with a sea breeze. Right next to East Coast Park, it's a favorite spot for weekend family meals and post-cycling suppers.
openingHours: 周一至周四及周日 11:00 AM - 10:00 PM, 周五至周六 11:00 AM - 12:00 AM (各摊位时间略有不同)
openingHoursEn: Mon-Thu & Sun 11:00 AM - 10:00 PM, Fri-Sat 11:00 AM - 12:00 AM (varies by stall)

name: G7 Frog Porridge & Live Seafood
description: 芽笼知名的老牌海鲜与田鸡粥餐厅，招牌宫保田鸡和姜葱田鸡肉质鲜嫩，酱汁浓郁，搭配绵密的砂煲白粥是绝佳的宵夜选择，同时也提供辣椒螃蟹等丰富的本地特色煮炒海鲜。
descriptionEn: A well-known heritage seafood and frog porridge restaurant in Geylang. The signature Kung Pao frog and ginger-scallion frog are tender with rich sauce, paired perfectly with creamy claypot rice porridge — a great late-night supper. Also serves chilli crab and other local zi-char seafood dishes.
recommendNote: 冲着田鸡粥来的老饕别只顾着吃田鸡，红烧鳄鱼尾也是这里的隐藏王牌——皮糯肉嫩，酱汁浓香入味，胆子大的一定要试试。
recommendNoteEn: If you're here for the frog porridge, don't stop there — the braised crocodile tail is a hidden gem too: chewy skin, tender meat, rich savory sauce. Adventurous eaters, give it a go.

restaurantFeatures.reservationDifficulty: 高峰期或多人聚餐建议提前预订，平时可直接前往
restaurantFeatures.reservationDifficultyEn: Reservations recommended during peak hours or for large groups; walk-ins fine otherwise

name: LAVO Italian Restaurant & Rooftop Bar
nameCn: LAVO 意式餐厅与露天酒吧
description: 位于滨海湾金沙酒店1号塔楼57层，集现代意式美式餐饮与高空酒吧于一体。拥有俯瞰滨海湾与新加坡天际线的180度绝佳视角，是欣赏落日、夜景与打卡招牌巨型肉丸的超人气高空餐厅。
descriptionEn: Located on the 57th floor of Tower 1 at Marina Bay Sands, combining modern Italian-American dining with a rooftop bar. Offers a stunning 180-degree view of Marina Bay and the Singapore skyline — a hugely popular spot for sunset, night views, and the signature giant meatball.
address: 10 Bayfront Ave, Tower 1, Level 57, Marina Bay Sands, Singapore 018956

signatureDishes: 招牌1磅重大肉丸 (The LAVO Meatball)
signatureDishesEn: The LAVO Meatball (1 lb signature meatball)
restaurantFeatures.dressCode: Smart Casual（晚餐时段男士需穿有领衬衫及长裤，不可穿拖鞋或无袖背心）
restaurantFeatures.dressCodeEn: Smart Casual (for dinner, men must wear a collared shirt and long pants — no slippers or sleeveless tops)
restaurantFeatures.reservationPlatform: Marina Bay Sands 官网 / SevenRooms

name: Samy's Curry
description: 新加坡登布西山（Dempsey Hill）历史悠久的印度餐厅，创办于1950年代。以传统芭蕉叶盛装米饭、招牌咖喱鱼头及香料羊肉闻名，保留了风扇敞开式的复古食堂氛围。
descriptionEn: A historic Indian restaurant at Dempsey Hill, established in the 1950s. Famous for rice served on traditional banana leaves, signature fish head curry, and spiced mutton — all in a retro, open-air, fan-cooled dining hall.

restaurantFeatures.reservationDifficulty: 高峰及周末建议提前预订
restaurantFeatures.reservationDifficultyEn: Reservations recommended during peak hours and weekends

name: Stella Seaside Lounge
description: 位于樟宜海岸的巴厘岛风情海滩餐吧，紧邻大海。提供海滨露台及舒适的沙滩沙发座位，是欣赏浪漫日落、周末朋友小聚和情侣约会的绝佳网红打卡地。
descriptionEn: A Bali-style beach lounge right on the Changi coast. Offers a waterfront terrace and comfy beach sofa seating — a popular spot for romantic sunsets, weekend hangouts with friends, and date nights.
openingHoursEn: Tue-Fri 4:00-10:00 PM, Sat-Sun & public holidays 12:00-10:00 PM, closed Mondays

restaurantFeatures.reservationDifficulty: 强烈建议提前1-2周预订，节假日有最低消费政策
restaurantFeatures.reservationDifficultyEn: Strongly recommend booking 1-2 weeks ahead; minimum spend applies on holidays

name: Mellben Seafood
description: 位于宏茂桥的知名老牌海鲜煮炒店，以螃蟹料理闻名全岛。其镇店之宝“砂煲螃蟹米粉”有着浓郁鲜甜的奶白色高汤，吸满海鲜精华的米粉搭配肥美的螃蟹，是每桌必点的招牌佳肴。
descriptionEn: A well-known heritage zi-char seafood restaurant in Ang Mo Kio, famous island-wide for its crab dishes. The signature claypot crab bee hoon features a rich, sweet, milky broth with noodles soaked in seafood flavor, paired with plump crab — a must-order at every table.

restaurantFeatures.reservationDifficulty: 建议提前预订，周末往往需要排队
restaurantFeatures.reservationDifficultyEn: Reservations recommended; weekend queues are common

name: Nana Original Thai Food
description: 位于 Aperia Mall 内部，主打地道正宗的泰国料理。提供来自泰国东北部、北部、南部和中部的风味美食。营业至凌晨 5 点，是深受夜猫子喜爱的平价夜宵去处。
descriptionEn: Located in Aperia Mall, specializing in authentic Thai cuisine. It offers a variety of flavors from Isaan, Northern, Southern, and Central Thailand. Open until 5 AM, making it a popular and affordable late-night supper spot.
recommendNote: 非常适合和朋友深夜聚餐，推荐这里的泰式炒河粉（Pad See Ew）和冬阴功汤。
recommendNoteEn: Great for late-night gatherings with friends. Highly recommend their Pad See Ew and Tom Yum soup.
